title: OverTheWire Natas: Server-Side Web Security Practice
summary: Natas teaches server-side web-security concepts through a series of purpose-built OverTheWire training websites. The provider recommends learning Unix/Linux foundations before taking this web-security path.
defensive_use: Study how a training application's trust and access boundaries should work. Keep notes about the expected control and defensive principle, without reproducing challenge credentials or publishing solutions.
prerequisites: A web browser and basic familiarity with web requests.
Unix/Linux foundations are helpful; the provider's overall sequence places Bandit before Natas.

access.note: OverTheWire's rules state that its community-hosted educational resources are free. Actual level access and service availability were not tested.
